login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in with the username and password the alliance administrator created for you.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask an administrator to set a new one.

fields.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a lowercase letter, an UPPERCASE letter, a digit and a symbol.
